messages.snippet: Dear Helen, We're running confirmatory IP diligence on the AB-COAT(TM) family for the Brandt licence
messages.subject: Project Quartz — patent status confirmations needed
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Helen,

We're running confirmatory IP diligence on the AB-COAT(TM) family for the Brandt licence. Could you confirm for each of the five family members: current status, proprietor of record, renewal position, and any oppositions/observations? We're particularly interested in EP4123901A1 (we understand examination is ongoing) and the national-phase position of WO2023/118802.

Many thanks,
Elena

messages.snippet: Elena, Confirmations: GB2598412B, EP3984210B1 (validated DE/FR/IT/ES/NL) and GB2611507A all granted
messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — patent status confirmations needed
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Confirmations: GB2598412B, EP3984210B1 (validated DE/FR/IT/ES/NL) and GB2611507A all granted and in force, Aldridge sole proprietor, renewals paid. EP4123901A1 is in examination - one third-party observation was filed citing US2019/0241758, which we consider distinguishable; I'd put grant likelihood around 70%. WO2023/118802 has entered national phase in US, JP and CA. Chain of title from the inventors is clean (assignments dated 11 Jan 2021).

Happy to talk it through.
Helen
